_header: Shared git guard cases. Byte-identical in every repo that runs .claude/hooks/guard-git.py:
copy this file whole, never edit it in one repo. General cases are added to the canonical copy
first and then copied; a repo's own cases go in .claude/hooks/guard-git.cases.local.json.
guard_sha256 pins guard-git.py: change the guard and this file together, everywhere.
Copying between repos is by hand; the pins make a partial or local edit fail CI, nothing more.
Each case runs in a scratch repo holding scratch_files and scratch_config, on branch claude/test
('branch') or main ('main', which also gets scratch_config_main), with an empty HOME.
{branch_repo} and {main_repo} are replaced by those repos' paths; an optional cwd is sent as the
payload's cwd. expect: block = exit 2, allow = exit 0. policy_cases run against a copy of the
guard with that guard-git.policy.json beside it (null: none; a string: the file's raw text).
scratch_repos: more scratch repos (branch, extra refs, config) a case's 'on' can name.
